description: This file defines an abstract controller class 'BaseViewEmployeeController' within the OrangeHRM system, extending from AbstractVueController, implementing CapableViewController, and providing methods for authorization, rendering employee-specific views, and managing permissions.

classes.name: BaseViewEmployeeController
classes.description: An abstract controller class for viewing employee details, handling permissions, rendering employee-specific views, and integrating with the OrangeHRM front-end Vue components.

methods.name: getPimLeftMenuService
methods.description: Returns an instance of PIMLeftMenuService, instantiate if not already set.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Prepares and renders the employee view, adding properties like menu tabs and allowed file types to the Vue component.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to specify data groups for permission checks.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the capability to view the employee, throws exception if not accessible.

methods.name: setPermissionsForEmployee
methods.description: Sets permission data for a specific employee into the request context.

methods.name: isEmployeeAccessible
methods.description: Determines whether the employee can be accessed by the current user or if they are self.
